title: Ink Pastel demo: the life clock

shots.line: You open your eyes in a ruined city.
shots.scene: WIDE ruined street, hero and a neighbour, pills over heads

shots.line: Over his head, a clock: forty-one years.
shots.scene: HUD close-up on the neighbour, pill big

shots.line: Then a beam cuts across the street.

shots.scene: impact on the road + scars on the walls (R01 R02)

shots.line: Underground, Mom waits by the radio.
shots.scene: BUNKER medium, mom sitting, her pill
